reviewed_observations: The source form is static and contains no entered producer, contact, insured, insurer-name, or NAIC values.
PRODUCER occupies the left region from y=120 through insurer A; INSURED begins beside insurer B at y=180.
CONTACT NAME, PHONE, FAX, and E-MAIL labels occupy the upper-right rows; the insurer heading and NAIC heading precede insurer A through F.
No source-visible signature value is present.

defect.root_cause: The form graph already contained all 18 blank fields and all 14 source labels, but static groups were forced to canonical_mode=inert. Canonical output therefore retained a malformed predecessor candidate table and detached native/OCR contributors, duplicating labels and corrupting CONTACT/PHONE ownership.
defect.frontend_followup_root_cause: The generic form sidecar converted JSON value_state=empty into synthetic visible prose and repeated shared NAIC/insurer labels once per field instead of presenting the source-complete replacement as one region.
pre_fix_evidence: CONTACT/PHONE/FAX/E-MAIL and insurer labels were detached or duplicated in raw Markdown.
The predecessor output contained the corrupt token PHONE NAME:.
The first backend-fixed UI capture still contained Empty source-visible field and repeated shared labels.

backend: Admit replacement only for the exact resolved static parties-and-insurers group.
Require the six base fields, paired insurer name/NAIC fields, complete native labels, vector-backed contained blank fields, source-coherent geometry, no controls, no concerns, and no entered values.
Revalidate the complete contract at canonical render time and fail closed to no replacement content when it differs.
Render one source-ordered six-column Markdown grid with explicit blank value cells and exact-once labels.
frontend: Represent value_state=empty as an empty semantic value node, never synthetic user-visible prose.
Revalidate the exact complete parties-and-insurers contract before using the specialized semantic table.
Render one table with source-correct PRODUCER and INSURED row spans, one insurer-group heading, one NAIC heading, six insurer rows, and 18 blank value cells.

acceptable_differences: LlamaParse serializes this blank static region as raw HTML with three logical columns and row spans; the service raw Markdown uses explicit label/value cells while its semantic DOM restores the same row spans and source reading order.
The service JSON exposes typed form groups, fields, labels, blank value state, provenance, geometry, and canonical custody; the LlamaParse JSON envelope uses a different taxonomy.
analyzer_caveats: Document-wide token counts are not a valid duplication signal for PRODUCER or INSURED because those words also occur in source prose and the coverage paragraph; exact-once checks must be scoped to the parties table/canonical block.
Generic JSON type-sequence or nested-path diffs do not establish a form-fidelity regression across these two schemas.
Blank source fields must be checked through JSON value_state and empty DOM cells, not by requiring synthetic placeholder text.
